#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

typedef long long int64;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<pii> vii;

#define pb push_back
#define mp make_pair
#define fs first
#define sc second
#define sz(a) ((int) (a).size())
#define int64 long long
#define ldb long double
const ldb pi = acos(-1.0);

const int N = 20;
const double eps = 1e-10;
int n, k;
double a[N], p[1 << N], res[N];

int main() {
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
	cin.tie(0);
	cout.tie(0);
	cin >> n >> k;
	int cnt = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
		cin >> a[i];
		if (a[i] < eps) ++cnt;
	}
	k = min(n - cnt, k);
	p[0] = 1;
	for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
		double suma = 0;
		bool ok = true;
		int cnt = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
			if (mask & (1 << i)) {
				suma += a[i];
				if (a[i] < eps) ok = false;
				++cnt;
			}
		if (!ok) {
			p[mask] = 0;
			continue;
		} else {
			double sump = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
				if (mask & (1 << i))
					sump += a[i] / (1 - suma + a[i]) * p[mask ^ (1 << i)];
			p[mask] = sump;
		}
		if (cnt == k)
			for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
				if (mask & (1 << i))
					res[i] += p[mask];
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
		cout << fixed << setprecision(10) << res[i] << " ";
	return 0;
}
